verdicts.title: Applications of Monotone Rank to Complexity Theory
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Raz's recent result \cite{Raz2010} has rekindled people's interest in the study of \emph{tensor rank}, the generalization of matrix rank to high dimensions, by showing its connections to arithmetic formulas.
